projects.trello_help: Where do I find the IDs? Open a Trello board and append .json to the URL (e.g.: trello.com/b/ABC/my-board.json). Look for "id" for the board and the "lists" array to get the list ID.
projects.jira_help: Where do I find the Project Key? It's the short uppercase prefix of all your tickets in that project. If a ticket is PROJ-123, the Project Key is PROJ.
projects.clickup_help: Where do I find the List ID? Open your list in ClickUp. In the URL (e.g.: .../v/l/li/1234567), the list ID is the numbers at the end.
projects.azure_help: Area Path? If your project uses subdivisions (Area Paths), enter it here (e.g.: MyProject\FrontendTeam). Leave it blank to send tasks to the Project's general inbox.

settings.smtp_provider_sub: SMTP provider for sending transactional emails and notifications.
settings.task_sync_sub: Configure how and when emails are automatically sent to owners and tasks are pushed to connected platforms (Trello, Jira, ClickUp, Azure DevOps) when Fireflies delivers a new meeting.
settings.auto_send_hint:
Flow: when a new meeting arrives via Fireflies it's first processed with AI (transcription, task and decision extraction). When processing finishes, the project admin gets a status email (including whether emails are missing on tasks or participants).

If this option is active, additionally, once the time set below has elapsed and provided all tasks have an owner email, emails and external tasks (Trello, Jira, ClickUp, Azure DevOps) are sent automatically without manual confirmation. If emails are missing at the timeout, the system does NOT send and notifies the admin to complete them.
settings.timeout_hint: Minutes from when the meeting arrives until emails are sent and tasks are created on the platforms. Suggestion: use 60 (1 hour) or more to give time to edit emails and participant names. The job checks pending every 1 minute.
settings.manual_mode_hint: Manual mode: if this option is inactive, emails and external tasks aren't sent until the curator dispatches them from the meeting detail. The meeting remains in the Meetings list waiting for action.
settings.fireflies_sub: Webhook that receives recordings processed by Fireflies.
settings.webhook_paste_hint: Paste this URL into the "Webhooks" section of your Fireflies dashboard.
